faqs.question: How does the drawdown limit work on Instant Funding accounts?
faqs.answer: Instant Funding uses a smart drawdown system. The maximum drawdown is typically set at 10% (or 8% depending on the account type) of the initial account balance. The daily drawdown is calculated based on the previous day's closing equity or balance, whichever is higher. Breaching these limits will result in immediate account closure.

seo.title: Instant Funding Drawdown Rules Explained

faqs.question: What is the payout schedule and how long does it take to process?
faqs.answer: Traders can request their first payout 14 days after placing their first trade on the funded account. Subsequent payouts can also be requested every 14 days. Once requested, payouts are processed within 24 hours, depending on the chosen withdrawal method (Crypto, Rise, or Bank Wire).

seo.title: Instant Funding Payout Schedule & Processing Time

faqs.question: Are there any prohibited trading strategies on Instant Funding?
faqs.answer: Yes, certain trading strategies are strictly prohibited to protect the firm's capital. These include latency arbitrage, high-frequency trading (HFT), grid trading, martingale strategies, and exploiting feed errors. Using these strategies will lead to the denial of payouts and account termination.

seo.title: Prohibited Trading Strategies on Instant Funding

faqs.question: Is the initial challenge fee refundable?
faqs.answer: Yes, the initial challenge fee is fully refundable. It is refunded to the trader along with their first successful profit split payout, provided they have met all the rules and successfully transitioned to a funded account.
